verdict.reason: Verified exhaustively at the exact commit under review (HEAD == origin/feat/self-review-loop, per .git/HEAD and .git/logs/refs/remotes/origin/feat/self-review-loop): no `.claude` directory exists anywhere in the tree. A top-level `Glob` for `.*` lists every tracked dotfile/dotdir (`.dockerignore`, `.prettierrc`, `.gitignore`, `.nvmrc`, plus a handful of nested package dotfiles) and none is `.claude`. Direct `Read` of `.claude/commands/self-review.md` errors "File does not exist." `.gitignore:191` ignores only `.claude/settings.local.json`, implying the rest of `.claude/commands/**` is meant to be tracked, not locally-only — yet even command files for long-established, independently-verified features are absent too: `.claude/commands/hunt.md` and `.claude/commands/spec-to-pr.md` (cited in docs/design/agentic-dev-loop.md:50,53 as the entry points for `scripts/agent/hunt.mjs` and `scripts/agent/spec-to-pr.mjs`, both of which I confirmed exist on disk) are equally missing. There is no sparse-checkout or local exclude filtering it out (`.git/info/exclude` is the untouched template; `.git/config` has no sparseCheckout). So the todo file's checkbox — `docs/tasks/active/20260917-self-review-loop-todo.md:70` `'- [x] .claude/commands/self-review.md — drives the bounded loop...'` — and its restatement in the Review section (line 107, `'/self-review' + the two workflow docs + agentic-dev-loop.md § 1.1`) and in the lessons file (`docs/tasks/active/20260917-self-review-loop-lessons.md:89`, `'/self-review.md' — called it "the identifier a rebuttal is addressed to"`) all assert delivery of a file that is not in the tree this PR is the tip of. CLAUDE.md:65 and docs/design/agentic-dev-loop.md:57 both describe `/self-review` — backed by `.claude/commands/self-review.md` — as the thing that "drives" the mandatory step-3 loop, so the doc's own promise is unmet by the diff. I found no counterexample under any name or path, and the commit-identity check rules out a checkout artifact, so this is not a sandboxing false negative.
